data.long_meaning: The name Kreethi is derived from the Sanskrit language and is the name of a goddess associated with wealth and prosperity. In Hindu mythology, she is often depicted as holding a lotus or a bowl of rice, symbolizing abundance and fertility. The name is also believed to bring good fortune and financial success. The name Kreethi carries the meaning “Goddess of wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kreethi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kreethi total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
